description: Exact 11D primitive triality packing on 144 sites, center density 9/256 (same as OBK).
encoding: For label x, write p=floor(x/64), q=x mod 64. First seven coordinates are bits of p (least significant first), modulo 2Z^7. Last four coordinates are q_i/2 modulo 2D4, where q_i=2*((q>>(1+i))&1)+(q>>5)+4*(i==0)*(q&1) for i=0..3. D4={z integral: sum z even}.
